status_updates_submitted_ck.name: status_updates_submitted_ck
status_updates_submitted_ck.value: "projects"."status_updates"."state" <> 'submitted' or ("projects"."status_updates"."status" is not null and "projects"."status_updates"."summary" is not null and "projects"."status_updates"."submitted_at" is not null)

tasks_dates_ck.name: tasks_dates_ck
tasks_dates_ck.value: "projects"."tasks"."due_date" is null or "projects"."tasks"."start_date" is null or "projects"."tasks"."due_date" >= "projects"."tasks"."start_date"

tasks_hours_ck.name: tasks_hours_ck
tasks_hours_ck.value: ("projects"."tasks"."estimate_hours" is null or "projects"."tasks"."estimate_hours" >= 0) and ("projects"."tasks"."remaining_hours" is null or "projects"."tasks"."remaining_hours" >= 0)
